text:
maya: Quick sync — onboarding zeta-70b-ext. I pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/zeta-70b-ext/v1/ and created a staging symlink on NFS at /mnt/models/zeta-70b-ext/v1 -> s3-fuse. Can someone confirm the weights layout matches our loader (expected shard*.bin + .index)? Also need to validate max_ctx before enabling large_context in prod.

ravi: I pulled the s3 listing, looks like filenames are model-00001-of-00008.bin etc — loader-compatible. One hiccup: there's an extra dir named "params" containing shard_meta.json and a few weight shards. Our loader expects shard files at the top level. Options: add a shim to flatten during staging or update loader to accept params/. Which do we want?

leo: re tokenizer: found a weird split on soft-hyphen (U+00AD) producing empty tokens in our count which inflates KV entries by +1 for each occurrence. Repro: 
```
>>> tokenizer.encode("co\u00ADoperates")
[  121, 0,  908, ... ]  # shows a zero-length token in middle
```
Suggest running `python -m tools/tokenizer_fuzz --model zeta-70b-ext` on a small corpus. I can patch the tokenizer to normalize soft-hyphen -> '-' or drop it.

ashley: Memory checklist: target node = 80GB GPU. Rough KV cache estimate: bytes ~= hidden_size * 2 (fp16) * max_seq * 2 (k+v) * batch_factor + overhead. With hidden_size=12288 and max_ctx=131072 that's multi-TB in logical bytes — impossible. Practically we need to cap max_ctx at ~65k for this config or use a KV encoding that halves peak. In our tests `kv_cache_format=blocked` reduced peak by ~25-35% vs interleaved.

infra-bot: deploy-check FAILED on canary: "OOM while allocating kv buffer: requested 24000000000 bytes". Full snippet: "AllocationError: cudaMalloc failed at kv_cache.cc:123 (requested 24000000000)". Canary used max_ctx=131072 and kv_format=interleaved.

ravi: @maya I prefer updating the loader to accept params/ — keeps s3 layout sane. I'll open a tiny PR today. Also +1 to lowering canary max_ctx to 65536 to validate sizing.

maya: OK. Action items: (1) @ravi open loader PR to accept params/ (2) @leo run tokenizer_fuzz and propose normalization patch OR a pre-tokenization hook (3) @ashley run exact per-GPU memory calc for 65k vs 131k and share numeric table (4) I'll flip canary to max_ctx=65536 and kv_format=blocked and re-run canary by EOD. :thumbsup:

ashley: noted — will post numbers in-thread (will include peak alloc, observed OOM threshold, and a recommended safe max).

leo: I'll also add a tiny integration test that asserts no zero-length tokens for common unicode categories so we catch regressions.

maya: thanks all — will report canary outcome. If infra-bot still OOMs we'll schedule a 15-min triage tomorrow.
